headline: Kajetan Schweighofer climbs to 12th as ARC-2 gold line rises

sections.text: Kajetan Schweighofer added 5.41 points to reach 54.44, moving from 14th to 12th on ARC-AGI-2.
The 15th-place gold line rose 4.31 points to 53.06. Kajetan's latest move follows his earlier return to the gold places, now with the cutoff climbing behind him.
